# Dovetail

> Help and documentation for Dovetail, the AI-native customer intelligence platform. Guides for Agents, Channels, Projects, Chat, Docs, and integrations.

- [Integrations](https://docs.dovetail.com/integrations/home.md): Find the right way to connect a tool to Dovetail: sources for customer data, connected apps for your own accounts, and the API, CLI, and MCP for builders.
- [Freshdesk](https://docs.dovetail.com/integrations/freshdesk.md): Import closed Freshdesk tickets into Dovetail as a source with your Freshdesk subdomain and API key, then analyze them in any channel.
- [Build on Dovetail](https://docs.dovetail.com/help/build-on-dovetail/index.md): Compare the Dovetail MCP server, REST API, and CLI, and pick the right way to reach your workspace data programmatically.
- [Dovetail API](https://docs.dovetail.com/integrations/dovetail-api.md): Create a personal API key for the Dovetail API, send data points to an API source, and find the developer docs and rate limits.
- [Agent triggers](https://docs.dovetail.com/help/agents/agent-triggers.md): Choose when an agent runs: on demand, on a schedule, on a Dovetail event, from an external webhook, or as a Digital Twin in chat.
- [Guide to writing instructions](https://docs.dovetail.com/help/agents/agent-instructions.md): How to write agent instructions that focus on outcomes rather than steps, with patterns for digests, taggers, summarizers, and competitor watches.
- [Idea actions](https://docs.dovetail.com/help/channels/idea-actions.md): Send an idea to Jira, Linear, Figma, or Claude, notify the customers behind it, and reach Channels data through MCP and the API.
- [Report prompts](https://docs.dovetail.com/help/docs/report-prompt-guide/index.md): Write prompts that generate focused reports in Dovetail, whether you build them from Docs, from Chat, or on a schedule with an Agent.
- [SCIM API](https://docs.dovetail.com/help/scim-overview.md): Provision, update, and deactivate users and groups automatically with Dovetail's SCIM 2.0 API, supported in Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.

This documentation is built and hosted on [Mintlify](https://mintlify.com), a developer documentation platform.
